rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the “Synthetic Biology Promotion Act” and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Synthetic Biology Promotion Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Requirements for Designation of Specialized Policy Agency for Synthetic Biology) Pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the Synthetic Biology Promotion Act, the Minister of Science and ICTmay designate an institution or organization that meets all of the requirements of each of the following subparagraphs as a specialized policy agency for synthetic biology.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Requirements for Designation of Specialized Policy Agency for Synthetic Biology) Pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the Synthetic Biology Promotion Act, the Minister of Science and ICT may designate an institution or organization that meets all of the requirements of each of the following subparagraphs as a specialized policy agency for synthetic biology.

rows.source_ko: 1. The business activities of the relevant institution or organization must include work related to supporting synthetic biology policies.
rows.text_en: 1. The business activities of the relevant institution or organization must include work related to supporting synthetic biology policies.

rows.source_ko: 2. Possess a dedicated organization and dedicated personnel capable of performing the duties specified in each subparagraph of Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Synthetic Biology Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”).
rows.text_en: 2. Possess a dedicated organization and dedicated personnel capable of performing the duties specified in each subparagraph of Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Synthetic Biology Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”).

rows.source_ko: 3. It must be equipped with dedicated workspaces and facilities necessary for performing the duties specified in each subparagraph of Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree .
rows.text_en: 3. It must be equipped with dedicated workspaces and facilities necessary for performing the duties specified in each subparagraph of Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree .

rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Science and ICT Decree No. 168, Apr. 22, 2026>

rows.source_ko: This rule shall take effect on April 23, 2026.
rows.text_en: This rule shall take effect on April 23, 2026.
